For odd n>=3, global tensor terms anticommute and square to I, yielding B^2=mI. Local anticommutation implies each local expectation vector has Euclidean norm <=1; generalized Holder gives exact product threshold 1 (attained by generator eigenstates). Measuring B/sqrt(m) gives probabilities p=(1+b/sqrt(m))/2, q<=(1+1/sqrt(m))/2; relative-entropy data processing and d_bin decreasing in q
